module.title: Inventory & Warehouses (Kardex)
module.subtitle: Manage items, warehouses, stock entries and the kardex ledger.

overview.title: Stock & Inventory
overview.subtitle: Perpetual inventory: posting a voucher writes its Kardex rows and balanced General Ledger lines in the same transaction.
overview.missingTenant: No tenant/company selected. Set VITE_TENANT_ID and VITE_COMPANY_ID in .env.development.

posted.summary: Posted {{voucherNo}} — Dr {{debit}} = Cr {{credit}} ({{glLines}} GL lines, {{kardexRows}} Kardex rows). Stock levels below were refreshed.

stats.locationsHint: Leaf nodes of the warehouse tree
stats.fifoHint: FIFO layers in Stock In Hand (1310)

warehouses.title: Warehouses
warehouses.subtitle: Stock balance and perpetual valuation per leaf location.
warehouses.empty: No warehouses yet for this company.

items.title: Items & Stock Levels
items.subtitle: Live SUM of the Kardex per warehouse. Posting an entry reloads this table.
items.empty: No items yet for this company.
items.loadFailed: Could not load the item list

movements.title: Recent Movements
movements.subtitle: Posted vouchers, newest first.
movements.empty: No stock movements yet — post a Material Receipt to open the ledger.

entry.title: New stock entry
entry.atomicHint: Posts atomically: Kardex rows + balanced General Ledger lines.

entryTypeHint.MaterialReceipt: Receiving goods: Dr Stock In Hand (1310) / Cr Stock Received But Not Billed (2120), FIFO layer valued at the unit rate you enter.
entryTypeHint.MaterialIssue: Consuming goods: FIFO layers flow to COGS (Dr 5210 / Cr 1310). Rejected when the warehouse cannot cover the quantity.
entryTypeHint.MaterialTransfer: Moving between warehouses: Kardex rows only, no General Ledger impact.

validation.noWarehouses: This company has no warehouses to post into.
validation.noActiveItems: This company has no active items to post.
validation.selectTarget: Select a target warehouse for the transfer.
validation.targetDiffers: Target warehouse must differ from the source.
validation.qtyPositive: Quantities must be greater than zero.
validation.rateRequired: Receipts need a unit rate: it opens the FIFO layer that later issues consume.
